strongest_angle: Break down the discovery of 2026 ED138 by the NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile, examining its estimated diameter between 600 and 1,500 kilometers beyond Pluto.

key_facts.fact: Astronomers at the NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile discovered a large trans-Neptunian object designated 2026 ED138 beyond the orbit of Pluto.
Preliminary data analysis and absolute magnitude calculations indicate that 2026 ED138 has an estimated diameter between 600 and 1,500 kilometers across.
The discovery of trans-Neptunian object 2026 ED138 was announced to the public by the International Astronomical Union Minor Planet Center.
Researchers including Matthew J. Holman and Mario Jurić characterized 2026 ED138 using data taken by the NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory with the linking code pointdexter.
